_doc: Per-object sprite overrides of /proto/ (top-down only): stable layout object id -> runtime sprite.
The object's type `t` does not change, so the layout (footprint, collisions, y-sort) and every legacy
consumer of the type (/next/, /full/, assets/) are untouched. `contact_from`: contact metadata is taken
from that type (the physical hull), not measured on the override (its spectral haze is not a base).
`shadow_opacity`: multiplier of the global contact_shadow.opacity for this object only.

spirit/shipwreck/ship.made_by: tools/make_ghost_ship.py from assets/feat_death_alt.webp (spectral restyle, same canvas/silhouette)
spirit/shipwreck/ship.why: the world ship of the dead reads as the same spectral ship as the spirit key art D; shadow variant B (25%): it floats, it is not a heavy house
